audit.whatIsWrong: The page told the reader the exact opposite of the truth twice. content whys[4], spikes[1] and mid all claim Aurora 'dodges his Destiny reveal' by 'going untargetable' with Between Worlds. Destiny reveals ALL enemy champions, and Between Worlds is not an untargetability effect at all — the invisibility in this kit belongs to Across the Veil, and a reveal is precisely what beats it. Separately, the page never mentioned that Pick a Card is an auto-attack reset.
audit.why: Riot's text: R 'predicts the fortunes of his foes, revealing all enemy champions and enabling the use of Gate, which teleports Twisted Fate to any target location in 1.5 seconds.' W 'chooses a magic card from his deck, and uses that for his next attack' — the kit carries an autoReset flag, so the stun arrives on an auto-attack, meaning the wind-up is the cue, not the cast.
audit.corrected: whys[4], spikes[1], content mid and report[5].t now state that Destiny reveals you and nothing in Aurora's kit hides from it, and that the answer to his 6 is winning the roam race. breakdown.cooldowns, dosFull[0].d, phases[2].why and tradeBad now carry the auto-reset tell from missingInteractions.

notes: The most serious defect on this page was not a name — it was advice that inverts a mechanic. Three fields told the reader Between Worlds makes her untargetable and dodges the Destiny reveal. Destiny reveals all enemy champions (the kit even carries the revealsStealth flag), and Between Worlds is a leap plus a slowing zone with a teleport, with no untargetability anywhere. A player following that line would hop expecting to disappear from a Destiny gank and die to it. Packet suspectNames are all false positives except the pluralisation: his Q is Wild Cards, and the page wrote 'Wild Card' in three places, which I corrected where I was already editing the field. I deliberately did not name the blue/red/gold card colours beyond 'gold', which the page already uses and which the kit's hardCC flag supports; the kit text says only 'chooses a magic card... causing bonus effects', so the specific colour-to-effect mapping is not sourceable from the brief and I wrote 'his card' plus the effect instead. content wants.you[2] claims E poke punishes his 'mana-hungry card cycling' — his costs do support that, so I left it.
